description: This file defines a Flutter widget called RideBottomSheet, which displays ride details such as distance, fare, and payment options, as well as a request ride button. It interacts with app state managed via Provider (RideState) and references shared constants and themes, serving as a UI component in a ride-hailing app.

classes.name: RideBottomSheet
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a bottom sheet showing ride details such as distance, fare, and payment options, and includes a button to request a ride.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the RideBottomSheet, consuming RideState and displaying ride details and actions.

methods.name: _showPaymentMethod
methods.description: Shows a modal bottom sheet for selecting payment methods.

methods.name: _onRequestRide
methods.description: Handles the event of requesting a ride, updates ride state, shows a confirmation snackbar, and dismisses the bottom sheet.
